extensionDescription.message: Send Chrome downloads to your ABDM server.

settingsDescription.message: Chrome downloads are captured after you configure the server. HTTP(S) downloads are enabled by default.

notConfigured.message: Configure a server to start capturing downloads.

extensionsHint.message: Common archive, installer, media, document, data, and image extensions are prefilled. Add more with commas or spaces. The list is used when the extension filter is selected.

syncNotice.message: These settings, including the token, are stored in Chrome Sync when it is enabled for your account. Extension storage is not encrypted.

cookieNotice.message: For signed-in downloads, matching browser cookies are sent only to the configured ABDM server for each captured download. Cookies are not synced.

syncInstructions.message: Generate a code on this device. On another Chrome device signed into the same account, load this extension with the same ID, then press Read code. Matching codes prove this setting arrived there. Local reading alone does not prove cloud sync.

invalidServerResponse.message: This is not a compatible ABDM Server response.

serverNeedsUpdate.message: The server is reachable but does not use the pinned ABDM engine. Update the server before using login downloads.

invalidServerAddress.message: Enter a valid IP or hostname and port.

linkFailed.message: Could not send this link to ABDM Server.

unsupportedLink.message: Only HTTP(S) links outside the server can be sent.

notPaused.message: Chrome kept this download because it could not be paused.

fallback.message: Server handoff failed; Chrome continues the download.

duplicateRisk.message: Handoff could not be rolled back. Check both Chrome and ABDM for a duplicate.

unexpectedError.message: Unexpected capture error. Check extension service worker logs.
